title: 4.2 Furniture and Home Objects
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
goal: Recognize and name six home objects, say which room they are in, and answer Is it a ...? about them.
grammar_function: It is a + noun. The bed is in the bedroom. Is it a door? Yes, it is. / No, it is not.
prerequisite: 4.1 rooms; 2.4 It is a ...; 3.4 yes/no questions with be.
speaking_outcome: Name six home objects and say which room they are in.
